caption: 01 · INPUT — What enters the aesthetic system?. Inventory references, materials, bodies, techniques, constraints, memories, commissions, budgets, deadlines, collaborators, and cultural knowledge. Attach origin, permission, credit, context, and transformation status to every consequential input.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what enters the aesthetic system? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · RULE — How does an input change a decision?. Translate a mood into a testable relation: if the material has this weight, the silhouette permits this movement; if the image uses this distance, the body retains this agency. Preserve exceptions and who may authorize them.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how does an input change a decision? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · LOOP — How does the system learn?. Connect sample, fitting, wearer response, production constraint, image review, sales signal, repair evidence, criticism, and archive return. Record which feedback changed the work and which was rejected with reason.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how does the system learn? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · RIGHTS — Which outputs or identifiers may be protected?. Map exact works, marks, registrations, contracts, designs, files, and confidential methods separately. Do not convert system documentation into a claim that the overall aesthetic is automatically copyrighted or registrable.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: Systems can make work scalable and reviewable; they can also become bureaucracy, optimize toward what platforms reward, and harden a founder’s bias into process. A healthy aesthetic system includes exit ramps, minority reports, ethical review, and protected zones for experiment that do not need immediate justification.
